relation.rationale: The readings are completely different words ('Hochzeitliches' vs 'Auch'), indicating a lexical difference.

The C edition includes the full title 'Selig iſt der gepreiſet' and the phrase 'Zu dir von hertzen grunde', whereas the D edition omits these titles and replaces them with a conjunction 'und' and a different list structure. This constitutes a difference in wording/lexical content.
The readings differ between the verb 'ist' (is) and the conjunction 'und' (and), which are distinct words with different meanings and grammatical functions.
Difference between 'um' and 'umb' is a spelling variation (presence/absence of b) for the same preposition/particle.
Different verbs (thut vs. wird) with different meanings
